description: This PHP file contains a class 'Banner' that manages banner modules in the OpenCart admin interface. It includes methods for displaying the banner configuration page, saving banner data, adding new banners, and deleting banners, while handling permissions, loading models, and rendering views.

classes.name: Banner
classes.description: Controller class for managing banner modules in OpenCart's admin panel. Handles CRUD operations and rendering of the banner configuration interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the banner module configuration page, loading necessary data and rendering the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving banner module configurations via AJAX, including validation and permission checks.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new banner module, requiring modify permission.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an existing banner module based on provided module_id, with permission verification.
